query.user: I have a question about a world record

function.name: get_world_record
function.description: Fetches details for a world record, which may include the record holder's name, the nature of the record, the date it was set, and any other relevant information or statistics.

record_category.description: The category of the world record. Examples include 'tallest man', 'fastest swimmer in Olympics', 'oldest person', etc.
